petal_gap.question: Subtract the setosa mean petal length from the virginica mean petal length. Return how far apart those two means are.

cases.input: Virginica mean petal length 5 and setosa mean petal length 1.
cases.expect: The gap is virginica minus setosa.

mean_low.question: Build the 95 percent confidence interval for virginica sepal width. Return the lower end only, the mean minus the margin. Do not return the upper end or the width.
mean_low.reference:
sv = df[df.species.isin(["setosa", "versicolor"])]
best, best_d = None, 0
for c in ["sepal_length", "sepal_width", "petal_length", "petal_width"]:
    a = sv.loc[sv.species == "setosa", c]
    b = sv.loc[sv.species == "versicolor", c]
    pooled = math.sqrt(((len(a)-1)*a.var(ddof=1)+(len(b)-1)*b.var(ddof=1))/(len(a)+len(b)-2))
    d = abs((b.mean()-a.mean())/pooled)
    if d > best_d:
        best, best_d = c, d

import numpy as _np
from scipy import stats as _ss
xv = df.loc[df.species == "virginica", "sepal_width"]
nn = len(xv)
mm = xv.mean()
sse = xv.std(ddof=1) / _np.sqrt(nn)
lo, hi = _ss.t.interval(0.95, nn - 1, loc=mm, scale=sse)
w = round(round(hi, 4) - round(lo, 4), 4)
mean_low = lo

cases.expect: The result is the lower end, not the upper end and not the width.

cases.input: An interval centered on a mean.
cases.expect: The lower end is the mean minus the margin.

anova_f.question: Run an ANOVA on petal length across the three species. F measures how far apart the group means are compared with the spread inside the groups. Return that F statistic, not the p-value by itself.
anova_f.reference:
x = df.loc[df.species == "virginica", "sepal_width"]
n = len(x); m = x.mean(); s = x.std(ddof=1)
t = stats.t.ppf(0.975, n-1)
lo, hi = m - t*s/math.sqrt(n), m + t*s/math.sqrt(n)

from scipy import stats as _ss
grps = [df.loc[df.species == s, "petal_length"] for s in ["setosa", "versicolor", "virginica"]]
Fv, pv = _ss.f_oneway(*grps)

cases.input: Group means far apart compared with the spread inside groups.
cases.expect: The result is a large F statistic, not a p-value by itself.
